shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null && git ls-files | head -50
cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html; ls __agent_eval__; grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/

cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -40; npm view @gravity-ui/uikit version dist-tags 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/ThemeProvider 2>&1 | head -30

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/theme && cat ThemeProvider.d.ts ThemeContext.d.ts ThemeSettingsContext.d.ts types.d.ts index.d.ts constants.d.ts; ls ..| grep -i -E "radio|segmented|switch|button$"

cat useTheme.d.ts useThemeValue.d.ts useThemeType.d.ts; cat ../Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -30; cd /home/sandbox/workspace; grep -rn "Sun\|Moon" node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json 2>&1 | head -2; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui
